author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.93 shipped: Battery SOC from a second local source when the main Envoy source drops
summary: Battery SOC from a second local source when the main Envoy source drops
why: The Envoy coordinator fails nightly around 23:00 when production.json?details=1 hangs, taking native battery SOC unavailable for 30-55 minutes while the realtime battery sensor from another integration keeps reporting. EC falls back to last-known-good SOC in that window. A trusted second local source closes the gap without touching the native path; trust gating, settle and slew bound keep a junk reconnect value out.
implications: Shipped ENVOY-STREAM-SOC-TIER-1 at v5.103.93; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.93.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the stream serves while native is available, if trust never reaches 3 agreements in daytime, or if the upstream Envoy per-endpoint isolation fix lands and drops stop.

refs.release_notes: Optional local battery stream tier for EC SOC: used only while native SOC is unavailable, after earning trust (3 agreements, 6h freshness), with 60s reconnect settle and slew bound. Unset = no change. Options flow rejects stream==native and max age >300s without heartbeat. Tier 3, reviews A-D, name-diff clean.
